Legal.privacyMetaDescription: How PROVIN.LV processes personal data, cookies, and analytics after consent under GDPR. Clear and transparent.
Legal.privacyLead: This policy describes what personal data PROVIN.LV ("we") processes, why, for how long and with whom we share it, which cookies we use and how you can exercise your rights.

sections.title: 1. Controller
sections.body: Data controller: Nils Valainis, self-employed person (sole trader), reg. No. 09118711109, Jana iela 3, Tukums, LV-3101, Latvia. Contact for data protection matters: info@provin.lv, +371 29 502 039.

sections.title: 2. What data we process
sections.body:
When you order: first and/or last name (if provided), e-mail, phone, VIN or registration plate, listing link (if provided), free-text message and payment information (cards are processed by Stripe; we do not see card details).

Free listing check: the listing link and the contact details you provide.

Partners (businesses): company details, contact person name, e-mail, phone, order and billing history.

When you use the website: server logs (IP address, time, requested page) for security and troubleshooting, and cookies as described in sections 4-5 and 9.

We do not collect special categories of data (health, beliefs etc.).

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal basis
sections.body:
Fulfilling your order, preparing the report, consultation and order communication: performance of a contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).

Invoices and accounting: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).

Website security, abuse prevention and one reminder about an unfinished order: legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Analytics and advertising measurement with cookies: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time.

sections.title: 4. Essential cookies
sections.body: Without consent we only use cookies needed for the website to work: your cookie choice, language, theme and the partner account login session. The list is in section 9.

sections.title: 5. Analytics, advertising and Google Consent Mode
sections.body:
We use Google Consent Mode v2. The Google tag (Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads) loads on every visit, but until you consent it runs in "denied" mode: it does not set or read cookies and only sends Google cookieless signals without identifiers (for example time, page visited, browser type and consent state). Google uses them for aggregated visit and conversion modelling.

If you choose "Accept analytics and advertising" in the cookie banner: Google Analytics and Google Ads may set cookies; Meta Pixel and TikTok Pixel load to measure ad results; we store the first and last marketing source (page, referrer, UTM parameters, ad click IDs gclid, gbraid, wbraid, fbclid, ttclid) and, if you order, link it to the payment. After a purchase the Meta Conversions API may send the purchase event from our server with a hashed e-mail and phone.

Vercel Web Analytics counts visits in aggregate, without cookies.

You can change or withdraw consent at any time by deleting this site's cookies in your browser or by writing to us; the banner will appear again.

sections.title: 6. Processors and recipients
sections.body:
We share data only with service providers that process it on our behalf:

Vercel Inc. (hosting and data storage); Stripe Payments Europe Ltd. (payments); Google Ireland Ltd. (e-mail, Google Analytics, Google Ads); Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. (WhatsApp communication; Meta Pixel and Conversions API after consent); TikTok Technology Ltd. (TikTok Pixel after consent); Dropbox International Unlimited Co. (document storage); Google (Gemini API) and Anthropic PBC (support in preparing the report: we send only the VIN and technical vehicle data, not your name, e-mail or phone).

Vehicle data by VIN or plate is requested from the Road Traffic Safety Directorate of Latvia (CSDD) and vehicle history providers (for example carVertical, autoDNA, official dealer systems); your contact details are not shared with them.

We do not sell data.

sections.title: 7. Transfers outside the EU
sections.body: Some processors (for example Vercel, Stripe, Google, Meta, Dropbox, Anthropic) may process data in the USA. Transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where the processor is certified, or on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses (GDPR Art. 46).

sections.title: 8. Retention
sections.body:
Orders, reports and invoices: 5 years after the order (accounting rules and possible disputes).

Unfinished unpaid orders: up to 90 days.

E-mail and WhatsApp communication: up to 2 years after the last message.

Free listing check requests: up to 12 months.

Partner account data: during the cooperation and 5 years after it (billing).

Server logs: up to 30 days. Cookies: as listed in section 9.

sections.title: 9. Cookie list
sections.body:
Essential: provin_consent and provin_cookie_consent (your choice, 180 days); provin-site-theme (theme, 12 months); provin-b2b-locale (partner page language, 12 months); partner login session (7 days).

With consent: provin_attr (marketing source, 180 days); _ga and _ga_* (Google Analytics, up to 2 years); _gcl_au (Google Ads, 90 days); _fbp (Meta Pixel, 90 days); _ttp, _tt_enable_cookie, ttcsid (TikTok Pixel, up to 13 months).

sections.title: 10. Your rights
sections.body:
You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, restrict processing, object to processing based on legitimate interests and receive your data in a portable format. You may withdraw consent at any time; this does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing. We do not make decisions based solely on automated processing that have legal effects on you.

Send requests to info@provin.lv; we reply within one month.

You may lodge a complaint with the Data State Inspectorate of Latvia (Datu valsts inspekcija, www.dvi.gov.lv).

sections.title: 11. Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy. Material changes will be shown on the website or in the cookie banner. Version: 28 October 2026.

Legal.termsMetaDescription: PROVIN.LV terms of use: nature of the service, payment, refunds, distance contracts and withdrawal rights for digital content.
Legal.termsLead: These terms set out the legal relationship between you (the "Customer") and the service provider PROVIN.LV ("we") regarding use of the website provin.lv and ordering paid consultative services. Please read them together with the Privacy Policy. The main rules on price, payment and refunds, and the non-application of withdrawal rights to digital content, are set out in sections 5 and <section11>11</section11> (there: <note>the bold section on withdrawal rights and Cabinet Regulation No. 255, point 22.13</note>). The legal provider details are listed below.

termsSections.title: 1. Application of the terms and acceptance
termsSections.body:
1.1. These terms apply when you use the website provin.lv and when you order a PROVIN service.

1.2. By placing an order and ticking acceptance of these terms, the Customer confirms that they have read and fully agree to all clauses, including the authorization in section 3.5, and agrees to immediate performance of the service.

1.3. If the Customer does not agree to the terms, they must not order the service or use site features that require a contract.

termsSections.title: 2. Nature of the service and its consultative character
termsSections.body:
2.1. PROVIN primarily provides a consultative service: assessment, summary and recommendations based on vehicle identification data, the listing and available information (the "Report" or the "Service"). The consultative products on the site are PROVIN MINI and PROVIN AUDITS (prices shown on the site at the time of order). The Service helps you make an informed decision; it is not a government extract, an independent technical assessment, a mechanic's diagnosis, a legal judgment, or an official roadside vehicle inspection.

The assessment provided by PROVIN is a subjective expert opinion. It is not a legally binding certificate or technical certificate. PROVIN is not liable for financial losses that may arise if the Customer decides to buy a vehicle based solely on this consultative opinion.

2.1.A. Separately from the consultative Report, the site offers an independent product "Official dealer service history data" (hero: "DEALER DATA"): digital delivery of official dealer / manufacturer service history records, to the extent available for the VIN and supported brand. This product does not include PROVIN expert analysis or consultation. If no official records are available after ordering, the Customer is entitled to a 100% refund. Partially available records are valid delivery and do not justify a refund.

2.2. Conclusions in the Report are based on PROVIN's professional experience and the information available at that time. They are advisory. The final decision to buy the vehicle, to arrange checks with third parties, and to accept risks rests solely with the Customer.

2.3. The Service is not a full guarantee against every possible hidden defect, fraud or gaps in sources that PROVIN does not control.

termsSections.title: 3. Information sources and structure of the Service
termsSections.body:
3.1. To deliver the Service, PROVIN uses various information sources, including paid international databases, public registries and information submitted by the user. Each source is used under the provider's publicly available terms, B2B partnership agreements or another lawful basis.

3.2. The Customer does not purchase access to third-party databases. The Customer receives an original work prepared by PROVIN (an analytical opinion) in which data fragments may be used for quotation and interpretation to the extent permitted by law.

3.3. PROVIN structures the Service as analysis and consultation. PROVIN does not publish full third-party commercial reports as its own product and does not use third-party content in a way that would breach applicable rules. The Report prepared by PROVIN does not use third-party brand logos and does not automatically generate direct hyperlinks to full paid third-party reports on the customer side where that would conflict with applicable law. Depending on the order, information may be obtained under contract, from documents provided by the Customer, or from publicly available sources that may lawfully be used to prepare an analytical conclusion.

3.4. PROVIN AUDITS scope and paid history checks.

3.4.1. The PROVIN AUDITS price includes at least 2 (two), usually 3 (three), vehicle history checks in paid information sources (the "Base Checks"). PROVIN chooses the sources and their order based on the vehicle's country of origin, make and data availability.

3.4.2. A typical set of Base Checks is, for example, carVertical, autoDNA and official dealer or manufacturer service history data. Source names shown on the website are examples, not a commitment to use each of them in every order.

3.4.3. Official dealer data is available only for certain manufacturers and not for every vehicle, and is often unavailable. Its unavailability does not change the PROVIN AUDITS price and is not grounds for a refund; the refund in section 2.1.A applies only to the separate product "Official dealer service history data".

3.4.4. If a Base Check source has no data on the specific vehicle, PROVIN may, at its discretion, carry out one substitute check in another source (for example Carfax, Cebia or an origin-country register) to meet the minimum in section 3.4.1.

3.4.5. A check is deemed performed once the request in the relevant source has been completed, even if the source shows no records or only partial data for the vehicle. Such a result is also stated and assessed in the Report.

3.4.6. In some cases (for example vehicles from Italy, Austria, the United Kingdom, Japan, Korea, the USA, the United Arab Emirates or other countries with limited data availability) PROVIN may recommend additional paid reports. Additional reports are not included in the PROVIN AUDITS price and are optional. They are ordered only with the Customer's prior consent and payment, at a price PROVIN states before ordering. If the Customer declines, PROVIN prepares the Report from the Base Checks, and this constitutes full performance of PROVIN AUDITS.

3.4.7. The PROVIN AUDITS price does not include an unlimited number of paid checks. PROVIN does not undertake to use every possible database or register and does not guarantee that data on the specific vehicle will be available in any particular source or country.

3.5. Customer authorization and structure of the Service.
By ordering the Service, the Customer expressly authorizes PROVIN (as the Customer's technical consultant and representative) to access third-party information sources and databases on the Customer's behalf and in the Customer's interest, to obtain information about the specific vehicle. The Customer agrees that PROVIN's acquisition of information and payment in third-party systems is part of performing the consultative service ordered by the Customer, to the extent set out in section 3.4. PROVIN does not distribute third-party data as a standalone product; it uses that data as source material to prepare a personalized expert opinion for the Customer.

termsSections.title: 4. Public and state registries
termsSections.body:
4.1. Where the Report uses information from public or state registries (for example vehicle registry and insurance history data publicly available in Latvia, and similar), PROVIN uses it only in lawful ways and under applicable rules.

4.2. PROVIN does not carry out unauthorized automated harvesting (for example scraping) from third-party systems where that would breach the provider's terms or the law. If commercial data channels are used in future (for example paid company lookups), they are used under the relevant contract.

termsSections.title: 5. Order, price, payment and refund principles
termsSections.body:
5.1. Orders are placed electronically with the information PROVIN requests. Required: VIN (17 characters) or licence plate, email and phone. A listing URL is optional; if provided, it must be a valid link to a specific listing. Other fields follow the site form. For "Official dealer service history data", VIN (or plate) and contact details in Stripe Checkout are sufficient.

5.2. The service price is clearly shown on the site (order form / summary) at the time of order and includes applicable taxes where required by law. Current products and orientative prices: Official dealer service history data €24.99; PROVIN MINI €39.99; PROVIN AUDITS €99.99 (the exact price is the one shown before payment). Prices may change for future orders; for a given order, the price shown before payment confirmation applies.

5.3. Payment is handled by a third-party payment processor (for example Stripe). The legal basis and data processing for payments are described in the Privacy Policy and the processor's documents.

5.4. Payment for the Service is final. Given the nature of the Service (immediate start of digital content preparation), no refund is made after preparation of the Report has started, except as set out in section 11 and the 100% refund in section 2.1.A if official dealer data is not available. For PROVIN AUDITS, the unavailability or absence of data in an individual source (including official dealer data) is not grounds for a refund if the Base Checks under section 3.4 have been performed.

5.5. Prices are final. The service provider is not registered as a VAT payer for domestic supplies in Latvia, so no VAT is added. VAT registration number LV09118711109 is used only for transactions with VAT-registered businesses in other EU countries.

termsSections.title: 6. Performance, delivery and permitted delays
termsSections.body:
6.1. PROVIN aims to prepare and send the Report to the Customer's email within 24-72 hours of successful payment and receipt of complete order information, unless the site states otherwise. The same delivery window applies to "Official dealer service history data" (as shown on the site).

6.2. The deadline may be extended for force majeure, technical limits, need for further information from the Customer, or third-party service outages. PROVIN will inform you of a material delay in a reasonable way where possible.

6.3. The Report is delivered electronically (usually PDF or another unified format) unless stated otherwise.

termsSections.title: 7. Customer duties and warranties about submitted information
termsSections.body:
7.1. The Customer must provide true, accurate and complete information needed for the Service (for example a correct VIN or licence plate; if provided, a valid listing URL).

7.2. If the Customer submits third-party reports, document copies or other materials, the Customer warrants that they have the right to pass those materials to PROVIN for performing the Service and that their use does not infringe third-party rights.

7.3. The Customer is responsible for how they use the Report content, including decisions about information shared with third parties (for example the seller).

termsSections.title: 8. Intellectual property in PROVIN materials
termsSections.body:
8.1. The content of Reports prepared by PROVIN (text, structure, layout, brand where applicable) is PROVIN's intellectual property or is used under a lawful licence.

8.2. The Customer receives a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the Report for personal purposes related to evaluating that vehicle.

8.3. Without PROVIN's prior written consent, it is forbidden to sell the Report, distribute it at scale, publish it as one's own commercial product, or otherwise use it commercially in a way that infringes PROVIN's rights or third-party rights in source materials.

termsSections.title: 9. Limitation of liability and disclaimers
termsSections.body:
9.1. PROVIN is not liable for incompleteness, delays or errors in information from third-party databases, registries or services, because PROVIN does not fully control those sources.

9.2. PROVIN is not liable for indirect loss (for example lost profit or lost time) to the extent permitted by applicable law.

9.3. PROVIN's total liability to the Customer for one order is limited to the amount the Customer paid for that order, except where the law provides otherwise (for example intentional misconduct or personal injury).

9.4. Nothing in these terms may be read as a PROVIN warranty of the vehicle's technical condition, legal cleanliness in every respect, or elimination of all risks.

termsSections.title: 10. Personal data
termsSections.body: Processing of personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy, which forms an integral part of these terms as regards information about data.

termsSections.title: 11. Price, digital content and withdrawal rights (distance contract)
termsSections.withdrawalIntro: **Withdrawal rights and refunds.** This section clearly sets out how **withdrawal rights** (the right to withdraw from a distance contract) and **refunds** apply, especially for digital content and the exception under Cabinet Regulation No. 255, point 22.13.

subsections.heading: 11.1. General rule on withdrawal rights
subsections.body: In a distance contract, a consumer may have the right to withdraw within a set period under the Consumer Rights Protection Law and other legislation, except where the law and this section provide otherwise.

subsections.heading: 11.2. Digital content and Cabinet Regulation No. 255 of 20 May 2014, point 22.13
subsections.body: The Customer confirms and agrees that the Service consists of delivery of digital content not supplied on a tangible medium. When performance of the Service begins with the Customer's prior express consent and acknowledgement of loss of withdrawal rights (by ticking the relevant confirmation on the order form), the Customer loses the right of withdrawal under Cabinet Regulation No. 255 of 20 May 2014 "Regulations regarding distance contracts", point 22.13, and the Consumer Rights Protection Law.

subsections.heading: 11.3. Other consumer rights
subsections.body: Other consumer rights (for example to require conformity with the contract or to complain) remain available under applicable law.

termsSections.title: 12. Dispute resolution
termsSections.body:
12.1. We first try to resolve disputes by negotiation, using the contact details on the site.

12.2. If a dispute cannot be settled amicably, it is heard by the courts of the Republic of Latvia under the rules on jurisdiction, unless mandatory law gives the consumer a more favourable forum.

12.3. Consumers may also turn to the Consumer Dispute Resolution Commission or use other out-of-court mechanisms provided by law where applicable.

12.4. We reply to a written consumer complaint within 15 working days (Consumer Rights Protection Law of Latvia, Section 26.1).

termsSections.title: 13. Changes to the terms
termsSections.body: 13.1. PROVIN may amend these terms. The current version is published on the site. For orders placed before an amendment, the version in force at the time of the order applies, unless the law provides otherwise.

termsSections.title: 14. Governing law
termsSections.body: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Latvia and by European Union legislation to the extent it applies directly.

termsSections.title: 15. Contact
termsSections.body: Questions about these terms: info@provin.lv, +371 29 502 039. Service provider: Nils Valainis, self-employed person (sole trader), reg. No. 09118711109, Jana iela 3, Tukums, LV-3101, Latvia.

Legal.partnerTermsMetaDescription: PROVIN Business partner (business customer) terms: credits, billing, use of reports, liability and data processing addendum.
Legal.partnerTermsLead: These terms apply only to businesses and self-employed persons using the PROVIN partner account (PROVIN Business). Consumers are covered by the Terms of Service.

partnerTermsSections.title: 1. Parties and scope
partnerTermsSections.body:
1.1. Service provider: Nils Valainis, self-employed person (sole trader), reg. No. 09118711109, Jana iela 3, Tukums, LV-3101, Latvia, info@provin.lv, +371 29 502 039 ("PROVIN").

1.2. Partner: a legal entity or self-employed person registered in the partner account with a PROVIN invitation.

1.3. The agreement consists of these terms, the price list or offer sent to the Partner and the data processing addendum (section 14). The Partner accepts them by ticking the consent box at registration or by making the first purchase.

1.4. Matters not covered here are governed by the Terms of Service, except consumer protection rules (consumer withdrawal right), which do not apply to the Partner.

partnerTermsSections.title: 2. Services
partnerTermsSections.body:
2.1. PROVIN Business report: vehicle history and listing evaluation with an advisory recommendation, as described in sections 2-3 of the Terms of Service.

2.2. Official dealer data: manufacturer or official dealer service history records, as far as available for the VIN and make.

2.3. Prices: PROVIN Business from €69.99 and Official dealer data from €14.99 per report; the Partner's specific prices are in the account and price list.

partnerTermsSections.title: 3. Account and access
partnerTermsSections.body:
3.1. One account per business. The Partner is responsible for password security and for employees given access.

3.2. The Partner notifies PROVIN of suspected unauthorised access within 24 hours.

3.3. PROVIN may block the account immediately on reasonable suspicion of misuse or breach of these terms.

partnerTermsSections.title: 4. Credits and billing
partnerTermsSections.body:
4.1. Credits are prepayment, bought against a PROVIN invoice or by card in the account. One report order uses one credit of the relevant product.

4.2. Invoice payment term: 7 days unless stated otherwise. Credits become available after payment.

4.3. Credits are valid for 12 months from purchase. Unused credits are not refunded in money, except where PROVIN ends the cooperation without the Partner's fault or cannot provide the service for reasons attributable to PROVIN.

4.4. VAT: PROVIN is not registered as a VAT payer for domestic supplies in Latvia, so no VAT is charged to Latvian Partners. For VAT-registered businesses in other EU countries the invoice carries VAT number LV09118711109 and the reverse charge applies where required by law.

partnerTermsSections.title: 5. Refunds and credit return
partnerTermsSections.body:
5.1. Official dealer data: if the official system holds no record for the VIN, the credit is returned to the Partner's account automatically.

5.2. PROVIN Business: the report is fulfilled when the checks in section 3.4 of the Terms of Service have been performed, even if a source returns no data.

partnerTermsSections.title: 6. Delivery times
partnerTermsSections.body: Reports are prepared within 24-72 hours on working days from the order. Urgent orders are agreed separately (time and price). Times may extend due to third-party source disruptions; PROVIN will inform the Partner.

partnerTermsSections.title: 7. Use of reports
partnerTermsSections.body:
7.1. The Partner may use the report in its business and show or hand it to its customer within the transaction for that specific vehicle (purchase, sale, consignment, trade-in).

7.2. Not permitted: publishing the report openly (for example attached to a listing or via a public link), selling it separately, using it to build a database, removing the PROVIN brand or disclaimers, or altering its content.

7.3. The report content remains PROVIN's intellectual property; the Partner receives a non-exclusive, non-transferable right of use within the scope of 7.1.

partnerTermsSections.title: 8. Partner obligations
partnerTermsSections.body: The Partner provides the correct VIN or plate, uses reports for lawful purposes and makes clear to its customer that the report is an advisory evaluation, not a technical inspection or guarantee.

partnerTermsSections.title: 9. Liability
partnerTermsSections.body:
9.1. Limitations of liability are the same as in section 9 of the Terms of Service.

9.2. PROVIN's total liability per report is limited to the amount the Partner paid for it.

9.3. PROVIN is not liable for the Partner's obligations to its customers, including price, warranties and vehicle condition.

partnerTermsSections.title: 10. Confidentiality
partnerTermsSections.body: Neither party discloses the other's commercial information (prices, volumes, customer data) learned in the cooperation, unless required by law.

partnerTermsSections.title: 11. Term and termination
partnerTermsSections.body: The cooperation is for an indefinite term. Either party may end it with 14 days' written notice. PROVIN may end it immediately if the Partner materially breaches these terms. Refund of unused credits after termination follows section 4.3.

partnerTermsSections.title: 12. Changes
partnerTermsSections.body: PROVIN may change these terms by notifying the Partner by e-mail at least 14 days in advance. Continued use of the account after the change takes effect means acceptance.

partnerTermsSections.title: 13. Governing law and disputes
partnerTermsSections.body: The laws of the Republic of Latvia apply. Disputes are settled by negotiation or, failing that, by the courts of the Republic of Latvia at PROVIN's location.

partnerTermsSections.title: 14. Addendum: data processing agreement (GDPR Art. 28)
partnerTermsSections.body:
14.1. Where the Partner provides personal data of its customer when ordering (for example a name), the Partner is the controller and PROVIN is the processor.

14.2. Subject and purpose: preparing and delivering the report. Duration: the cooperation and retention under 14.8.

14.3. Data types: VIN, plate, listing link, the Partner's customer's name if provided. Data subjects: the Partner's customers.

14.4. PROVIN processes the data only on the Partner's instructions (the order) and ensures that persons with access are bound by confidentiality.

14.5. Security: encrypted connections (HTTPS), access control and signed sessions, access only for authorised persons.

14.6. Sub-processors: as listed in section 6 of the Privacy Policy. PROVIN gives 14 days' notice of a new sub-processor; the Partner may object.

14.7. PROVIN assists the Partner with data subject requests and notifies a personal data breach without undue delay and no later than 48 hours after becoming aware of it.

14.8. After the cooperation ends PROVIN deletes or returns the Partner's customer data, except what must be kept by law (for example accounting records for 5 years).

14.9. On request PROVIN provides the information needed to verify compliance with these obligations.
